A remote observer intentionally remains in Town; removed an obsolete both-in-boss-scene barrier.
Stale onGround after a test teleport invalidated the native dream-nail input. Wait for actual native landing before input; native tree hit and orb pickup subsequently passed.

Geometry checks passed but rendered title overlap exposed an unsupported direct transition from the main menu to a dynamic menu. These renders are excluded from acceptance; the final fixture must use native Options navigation.

PowerShell converted a null environment value to an empty string inherited by the legacy game runtime. The empty mode incorrectly selected KeyEssenceChecks before GrubChecks. Runner now removes variables via Env provider and the mode guard rejects empty strings. Other accepted cases have explicit nonempty modes and the intended FINAL PASS.
